subject: creature collapse and rest
defect: Several fainted bodies remain upright or float above the grass and some resting poses do not settle onto the ground
notes: The direct pose fixture needs confirmation in a real faint/rest transition; explicit hovering is visible in Trailpup and Veridian. Cloudreach resting Cloudfang Solmane and Tempestwing show clear ground separation in stills; flying faint states may have different gameplay rules.

subject: creature hurt and movement poses
defect: Hurt and moving frames often retain the idle silhouette so the state is difficult to read without a filename
notes: Still frames cannot establish locomotion timing; check production transition captures before scheduling animation work. Tidewake and Stormwood stills confirm the recurring state-read gap; judge motion before assigning animation timing.

subject: open terrain
defect: Broad level grass fields and sparse ordinary trees dominate Cloudreach views where layered elevated land and ledge detail should lead the route
notes: Code-blind location verdict. Some generic teleport stands may face away from authored elevated route; compare a route-grounded frame matrix before final assignment.

subject: map
defect: The map canvas shows headings and markers without visible terrain or road context for the displayed destinations
notes: First Shore is marked discovered but the Day 1 state may hide survey detail; both biome maps lack terrain/route context at this state.

subject: normal creature scale
defect: Several normal creatures read visibly shorter than the trainer in the shared near-framed scale view
notes: Apparent visual height varies with perspective and posture; compare with declared size and a level camera before adjusting assets. Stormwood near-framed size comparison confirms this in five additional species. Cloudreach smaller species remain below trainer size in the common stage; exact authored scale versus perspective needs verification.

subject: shiny creature finish
defect: Several shiny variants become near-uniform hot magenta and lose their ordinary species material and pattern identity
notes: Variants are easy to identify; Ripplet and Mosshell retain more form detail.

subject: ground pickup identity
defect: Candies and potions read mainly as small colored glows in Meadows while unrelated Tidewake pickups repeat one crate and Cloudreach potion/revive pickups read as plants
notes: Twelve Tidewake named families use the same small crate with hue changes; representative sightings are listed. Cloudreach potion_large appears as a glowing red-budded plant and revive as a blue flower. Five Cloudreach item frames did not isolate their subject. Stormwood candy is visible; 19 other planned pickup frames need targeted reshoot.

subject: summit aviary
defect: The summit landmark reads as a small skeletal dome on grass beside a separate court instead of a layered stone sanctuary and its night silhouette stays dark
notes: A recognizable distance marker exists but the hero structure is visually thin in approach and close views.

subject: catch camera distance
defect: Catch framing crowds the trainer and both creatures during aim then jumps close enough at strike and breakout to crop bodies and lose the orb path
notes: Code-blind review of complete dry First Shore wild catch sequence. Cannonback, Terrapup and trainer overlap at aim distance; impact circle dominates Cannonback. The catch failure and success states are genuine pinned rolls, but a second same-species body may be in the scene. Stormwood Voltwig/Terrapup capture repeats the tight overlap and cropped strike; the dark ground makes the chance text more legible than Tidewake. Cloudreach repeats this with trainer across Skyrill face, a second body behind, then tight overhead contact. Code-blind review.

subject: architectural landmark read
defect: Several Cloudreach destinations present sparse plain or disconnected structures with weak landmark-specific detail
notes: Usable approach frames support this; close observatory captures are pressed against the wall and should be reshot. Flight Aerie route/vista also lacks a recognizable built silhouette; route sampling may face away, so verify with authored approach. Stormward close views show isolated short walls, flat banners, detached cobble insets and a suspended emblem; its authored stand is usable.

subject: menu shell
defect: The full-screen charcoal menu with thin teal borders has little visual hierarchy or scenic connection to the illustrated world
notes: Same full-screen shell in Meadows and Tidewake production UI; assess Cloudreach and Stormwood before final shared exposure.

subject: secondary menu panels
defect: The Quests Build and Players panels leave most of their area empty around a few plain text lines or a single button
notes: The Day 1 fixture may explain empty panels, but the screen leaves large dead areas. Skills capture still resembles Quests; verify navigation.

subject: exposed landform edges
defect: Floating island undersides form blunt dark slabs and several cliffs and grassy shelves have conspicuous straight extruded edges
notes: Grouped as one recurring exposed-edge geometry defect; inspect whether cliff and island meshes share an authoring path.

subject: craft recipe text
defect: Long recipe names and material preview lines are clipped in the crafting list
notes: Ironwood Haft and Wood/Stone preview strings are cut off at 1920x1080; direct-open CraftPanel visual fixture. Cloudreach visual-only fixture repeats this presentation. Stormwood code-blind system view repeats this issue.

subject: catch effect finish
defect: The catch sequence uses a dominant saturated magenta ground ring and flat bright orb that lose depth beside the creatures, with little visible change between rest and shake frames
notes: Resting and shaking stills have little visible difference; motion and audio need separate review before judging shake timing. Tidewake normal fight repeats the flat yellow orb/magenta ring; rest and shake differ mainly by a small symbol, so the suspense beat is weak in stills. Stormwood dark ground gives more contrast, but the gold disc and magenta ring still dominate the rest/shake beat. Cloudreach tight overhead strike crops the target and makes the orb read as a bright puck; sighting merged after code-blind review.

subject: captain fight camera orientation
defect: During incoming warnings the camera repeatedly faces an empty part of the arena or crops the opponent and ally so the attack direction and exchange are difficult to read
notes: Code-blind review of full three-opponent live-input Captain Veyra fight. Aeriex and Cloudfang leave the frame during incoming cues; a later reverse angle cuts off Cloudfang head and much of Sparkit. Distinct from Meadows P2-062 where the nearby ally fills and clips the view. The challenge and victory callbacks succeeded.

subject: exploration HUD
defect: The many dark boxed HUD panels and outlined text occupy a large share of the exploration view
notes: Tidewake exterior confirms the large team strip quest box quick bar and shortcut bar; Meadows frame is indoors. Cloudreach flight frames show the same panels crowding airborne scenery. Coverage question: a pinned Tidewake build-system render found no production BuildPlacer; camp/bed/build/craft world views remain open pending a valid Tidewake path.

subject: mounted terrace edge and cloud crossing
defect: The mounted deer and seated trainer retain their upright riding silhouette while travelling below the cliff and then continue apparently unsupported across the cloud floor
notes: Capture deliberately steers the mount off a terrace, then asks it to ride back. Confirm normal input, grounded collision and fall recovery before deciding whether pose, camera or traversal state owns the fix. A recovery between sampled frames is not directly shown.

subject: bright Cloudreach route markers
defect: Saturated cyan posts rings and rails at the bridge and flight aerie compete with the built landmarks while the launch platform adds a bright flat yellow pointer
notes: Both bridge and aerie show similar saturated guide geometry. Whether all markers share one asset or several requires confirmation; scored once as the recurring marker family.

subject: fight team roster contrast
defect: The left team roster fades to pale low-contrast text against terrain during active combat
notes: Contrast varies by battle state; the roster is darker and legible at hit-001_22. Code-blind review. Stormwood team names likewise disappear into dense wet grass during tells. Full Venn run shows TEAM 5/5 while two entries are labeled KO; confirm whether the count means roster slots or active members before treating it as a defect. Cloudreach captain fight repeats low roster contrast against pale arena paving while health and status are relevant.
